intent: A dark, monochrome email-and-password sign-in card that rises from blur and staggers its contents in reading order; its focus ring is drawn by a point of light that runs once around the field from where you clicked. Every auth state is designed: invalid, loading, success, lockout with countdown, caps lock, SSO in flight.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (container queries); colour tokens in one PALETTE object as --si-* CSS variables
stack.animation: motion/react: motion values + useTransform for the focus light and wipe (no per-frame setState), AnimatePresence for swaps, imperative animate for shakes (stopped on unmount)
stack.icons: inline SVG only: Google, GitHub and Apple marks, eye, lock, alert

layout.card: max-width 400px, radius 20px, surface + inset hairline + top highlight + deep shadow; padding 36/32/32 from 384px container up, 28/24/24 below
layout.order: brand tile 40px → heading → subtitle → banner (lockout/error) → SSO grid → divider → email → password (Forgot? on label row) → remember-me → submit → sign-up line
layout.sso: equal-column grid, 8px gap, 44px tall, radius 11px, faint field fill, hairline inset ring
layout.fields: 44px, radius 11px, faint fill, hairline inset ring (stronger on hover); label 13px/500 8px above
layout.submit: 44px full width, accent fill with black-or-white text by contrast, radius 11px, 7% text-colour wash on hover
layout.code: hooks useTimeouts, useLockout, useShake, useBox; sub-components Banner, SsoRow, Divider, EmailField, PasswordField, FieldShell, FocusLight, PasswordInput, RevealButton, Checkbox, SubmitButton

typography.divider: 10.5px Geist Mono uppercase, tracking 0.16em, faint token

color.approach: monochrome; one accent prop (default = theme ink) on the submit button and the checked box; colour otherwise only for meaning (error, warning) and the Google mark
color.washes: color-mix() of error/warning at 5–8% with a 24–26% inset ring
color.success: no green: the button keeps its accent and draws a check
color.providers: Google keeps its four brand colours; GitHub and Apple marks take the ink

motion.focusLight: SVG rounded-rect path measured with ResizeObserver; t 0→1 over 800ms cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); ring dasharray t·P/(P−t·P) offset −start; comet = 6 stacked dashes ending at the head (tails 84/46/22px at .14/.28/.55, halo 16px×8px at .07 and 13px×4.5px at .16, core 10px×2.25px at 1); comet fades over the last 18%; start = pointer x on top edge minus radius, else top-left
motion.invalid: field shakes once x 0,−7,6,−4,2,0 over 420ms; message height auto + y −6→0 over 300ms ease-out
motion.reveal: eye lids flatten, pupil shrinks, slash draws with a mask gap (320ms); a ghost input holding the old rendering and the real input get complementary mask gradients with a 16% soft edge, sweeping left→right over 500ms
motion.submit: label → spinner → drawn check in the same 44px box; 8px offset + 3px blur cross-fade (220ms); stays accent on success; onSuccess after 700ms
motion.countdown: lockout digits roll (enter from −70%, exit to +70%, 320ms)
motion.entrance: once at 30% in view: card y 16→0 + blur 10→0 over 600ms; then mark → heading → subtitle → SSO buttons (30ms apart) → divider (hairlines scaleX outward) → email → password → remember → submit → sign-up, 45ms apart from 120ms, each opacity + 10px rise + 6px blur clearing over 450ms; ≈900ms total
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades only; ring appears without travel; no shakes or wipes
motion.cleanup: every timeout via useTimeouts (cleared on unmount); lockout interval cleared; shake and lap animations stopped on unmount

responsive.390px: three SSO buttons still fit with labels; 24px card padding; 16px inputs

accessibility: form noValidate with type=email, autocomplete=username and current-password, inputMode=email, autocapitalize=none
labels via htmlFor; aria-invalid and aria-describedby link each field to its message
field errors role=alert; a polite live region announces signing in / signed in / lock lifted
eye toggle is aria-pressed with the label 'Show password' and keeps the caret in the field on pointer toggles
caps lock detected with getModifierState and announced
SSO buttons labelled 'Continue with Google' etc; aria-busy while loading
2px ink focus-visible outline, offset 2px, no transition; presses scale .97–.98

content.title: Sign in to Halyard
content.subtitle: Welcome back. The backlog didn’t groom itself.
errors: That’s missing an @. Emails need one.
That password doesn’t match. 2 tries left.
Sign-in paused. Too many wrong passwords, so we’re giving this account a short breather.
content.result: onSubmit resolves {ok:true} | {ok:false, reason:'invalid_credentials', attemptsLeft} | {ok:false, reason:'unknown_email'} | {ok:false, reason:'locked', retryAfter}; throwing = network failure
content.demo: password correct-horse; three misses lock for 30s

avoid: a greyed-out disabled button for the lockout
outline-none on buttons (kills Tailwind v4 focus rings)
SVG blur filters on the comet (artifacts); use layered strokes
